title: Translate the untranslated Ur III administrative tablets
done_when: Every tablet has an English translation made from its published transliteration, damage notation kept, and a structured record whose year (king and regnal year), month name and first commodity two AIs of different vendors read the same way; the translation, the entries, the personal names and the year formula are kept as evidence for a reader who can check them against the sign list.
